title: Source-preserving patient symptom narrative records
description: Reported symptoms, recurring patterns, exposures, associations, hypotheses, medication responses and care preferences. Report time differs from symptom onset. Preferences and patient attribution do not establish diagnoses or causality. Patient-reported vital signs keep blood pressure components and pulse as separate source-backed values.

details.description: Patient-reported sleep for one night, dated by the morning it ended (occurrence). Duration is in hours, as stated or computed from stated bed and wake times. Quality stays in the patient's words. Unreported elements are null, never estimated.

occurrence.description: Date of the reported episode or assessment, distinct from report timestamp and symptom onset.

timeOfDay.description: Reported part of day for an exposure, symptom change or measurement. Distinct from an exact clock time, which stays unknown unless reported.
